body:
PR #2794 at 06191d581c (0 behind; merged 7be4321436 #2781 BUG-2187; no rebase, no force-push). Two conflicts, resolved:
- session.rs spawn_vendor_headless_with_seat_granted: took #2781's apply_child_agent_identity (sets AIDA_AGENT_TYPE + AIDA_AGENT_NAME) and dropped my own AIDA_AGENT_TYPE line plus the now-unused HeadlessVendor::agent_type(); BUG-2187 supersedes that part of my change. The call still sits after the ceiling env, and task1169_launcher_sets_ceiling_guardrail passes 2/2.
- queue_cmd.rs run_standalone_reviewer: kept #2781's structure (shared 'outcome' + ReviewerVendorExit for a non-zero exit + recovery text). My denials are now parsed from #2781's log_body, which is read whenever collection fails, and passed into standalone_reviewer_outcome before the recovery text is appended, so a denial is named on the exit-0 (code 30) and the non-zero-exit paths alike.
Tests: bug_2187_reviewer_record_identity 1/1, bug_2201 e2e 2/2, ceiling guardrail 2/2.
Gates: check-ci-fast PASS; test-touched: one run 907/908 (the recurring bug_1983 one_rejection_table grant-file flake, 4th sighting), the next run clean 908/908 + 2/2. I'd file the bug_1983 flake separately; it predates my lib test (first seen in round 1).
subject: PR-2794 merged with #2781: 06191d581c
